notes: Two structural changes from PROFORMA-SPEC §17, which is the owner's statement of what this system is for. Periods are quarters, out to 24 The engine projected annual periods. That was wrong three ways: an analyst builds the next quarter, then two, then three, out to six years; consensus and guidance are published quarterly, so an annual grid cannot consume them; and annual periods discard seasonality entirely. The growth driver has been year-over-year same-quarter since it was built (fmp:income-q yoy-same-quarter), so projecting each quarter off the quarter a year before it carries seasonality
